row.body: A hammer and unopened nails sit beside a note to brace the garden-side door before the next treatment. The note does not say who will return.
row.title: Fortification order

sidecar.gloss: A door is reinforced ahead of a treatment, with no return plan.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew might secure a building after any hazard; the timing of the treatment is not recorded.

row.body: Farm log: “fortify here” meant boards over the garden door before the next treatment truck. The crew promised to collect its sample jars and never returned.
row.title: Fortify before the treatment

sidecar.rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

row.body: Diary margin: the first heart marks the cot where the orchard crew slept after the spray run. Their boots left a sweet yellow dust; the family returned before anyone posted a warning.

row.body: On the photograph back: second heart, our spare blanket. I rinsed green flecks from it after the seed-treatment men left, then the well began tasting of pennies.
